findings.note: Lead petitioner on House bill H.799, An Act decoupling the municipal census from voter registration, described as legislation to further regulate voter registration rolls. The text limits when a voter's name can be removed from the register to listed reasons (for example a written request, death, felony incarceration, registration elsewhere, or moving away, after notice and hearing) and replaces removal for not returning the census with a fine. Referred to the Election Laws committee on 2/27/2025; hearing held 9/16/2025.
subjects: removal of voters from registration rolls
